channel.title: DailyBite — Daily Food Deals
channel.description: The best verified food deals, updated every morning.

item.title: Shake Shack: Any Frozen Custard for $3
item.description: Use promo code CUSTARDTIME at any in-restaurant kiosk, the Shake Shack app, or online to get any frozen custard for $3 — no membership needed. (Through August 19, 2026)

item.title: Panera Bread: Mix & Match Menu at $4.99 Each
item.guid: Panera Bread-Mix & Match Menu at $4.99 Each-2026-08-03
item.description: Save about 40% off regular prices by ordering from the Mix & Match $4.99 menu — choose up to 10 half-portions of soups, sandwiches, and salads, plus one side per order. (Ongoing)

item.title: Krispy Kreme: Orange Dreamsicle Dozen for $5 with Any Dozen Purchase
item.guid: Krispy Kreme-Orange Dreamsicle Dozen for $5 with Any -2026-08-03
item.description: Buy any dozen at regular price and add an Orange Dreamsicle Original Glazed Dozen to your order for just $5 — available in-shop, drive-thru, or online for pickup or delivery, no membership required. (Limited time)

item.title: Shake Shack: App Everyday Menu: $2 Sodas, $4 Fries, $6 Shakes
item.guid: Shake Shack-App Everyday Menu: $2 Sodas, $4 Fries, $-2026-08-03
item.description: Order through the Shake Shack app or website at participating locations to unlock $2 sodas, $4 crinkle-cut fries, and $6 shakes all day. (Ongoing)

item.title: Taco Bell: Build Your Own Luxe Cravings Box for $7
item.guid: Taco Bell-Build Your Own Luxe Cravings Box for $7-2026-08-03
item.description: Pick a specialty item like a Crunchwrap, plus a taco or Beefy 5-Layer Burrito, a side, and a drink — all in one box for $7 via app or in-store. (Ongoing)

item.title: Papa Johns: 50% Off Regular Menu-Price Pizzas on Carryout
item.guid: Papa Johns-50% Off Regular Menu-Price Pizzas on Car-2026-08-03
item.description: Order carryout at Papa Johns for a limited time and get 50% off regular menu-price pizzas — no promo code required, just order online or in the app. (Limited time)

item.title: Jack in the Box: 2 Tacos for $1.29 in the App
item.guid: Jack in the Box-2 Tacos for $1.29 in the App-2026-08-03
item.description: Order through the Jack in the Box app and grab two classic tacos for just $1.29 — a standing digital exclusive deal available any time, day or night. (Ongoing)

item.title: Arby's: Meat & 3 Box for $7.99
item.description: Get a Roast Beef or Crispy Chicken Sandwich, your choice of three sides, and a small drink for $7.99 — a standing everyday value box available in-store and online. (Ongoing)

item.title: Chipotle: Free Delivery on $10+ Digital Orders
item.description: Chipotle is waiving the delivery fee on digital orders of $10 or more for a limited time. Order in the app or at chipotle.com - no code needed, open to everyone. (Limited time)

item.title: Sweetgreen: Alice Waters' Peach & Goat Cheese Salad
item.description: Limited-edition summer collab with chef Alice Waters - a seasonal peach & goat cheese salad available nationwide in-app and in stores, with 1% of proceeds donated to the Edible Schoolyard Project. (Through August 10, 2026)
